page_title: WHU 1-1 TOT | West Ham v Tottenham Hotspur 04/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+4' Close! James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) stands over the resulting free kick from around 22 metres out and his shot goes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
90+3' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. West Ham are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
90+1' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' The linesman signals that Mikey Moore (Tottenham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
89' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is flagged for offside.
88' The foul by Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Michael Oliver.
88' It is time for a substitution. Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) is on for Aaron Cresswell.
86' Carlos Soler (West Ham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
84' Ben Davies (Tottenham) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.

82' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) latches onto a precise lofted pass into the penalty area and produces a header at goal, but his attempt to the right side of the goal fails to beat Guglielmo Vicario, who makes a sensational save.
81' Kevin Danso (Tottenham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. West Ham have a free kick.
80' Carlos Soler (West Ham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tomas Soucek.
80' Substitution. Jean-Clair Todibo is replaced by Vladimir Coufal (West Ham).
80' Here is a change. Lucas Paqueta is going off and Graham Potter gives the last tactical orders to James Ward-Prowse (West Ham).
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Evan Ferguson (West Ham) coming on for Niclas Fullkrug.
79' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
76' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
73' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
72' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Michael Oliver blows his whistle for an infringement.
72' Tottenham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' Djed Spence (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Tottenham get a corner.

71' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) comes close to scoring. He meets a lovely lofted pass from Mohammed Kudus, but sends his close-range header way over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
69' Mikey Moore (Tottenham) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
69' Djed Spence (Tottenham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Tottenham are going to take it.
68' Richarlison will be replaced by Mikey Moore (Tottenham).
67' Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
66' Emerson (West Ham) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
65' Richarlison (Tottenham) is adjudged offside.
64' Michael Oliver blows his whistle. Max Kilman (West Ham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
62' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

61' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
61' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
60' Djed Spence (Tottenham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Good work from Tottenham as they win a corner.
58' A cross into the box picks out Jarrod Bowen (West Ham), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
58' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
57' Richarlison (Tottenham) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
56' Dangerous play by Max Kilman (West Ham). Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
55' The foul by Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) was seen by Michael Oliver who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
54' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked.

54' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.

52' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
51' Michael Oliver interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Yves Bissouma (Tottenham).

49' A through ball from Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) fails to reach Mohammed Kudus as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Mohammed Kudus could have got into a promising position.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Richarlison (Tottenham) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

43' A lofted cross from Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. West Ham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
42' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
41' Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul after Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) hacks down one of his opponents.
39' Richarlison (Tottenham) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
37' The possession of the ball – 56:44.
35' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
34' Djed Spence finds Richarlison (Tottenham) inside the box with a nice lofted pass, but he balloons the shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
33' Michael Oliver blows for a foul after Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
33' Djed Spence (Tottenham) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
31' Djed Spence (Tottenham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Michael Oliver saw the whole situation.

28' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Aaron Wan-Bissaka slips the ball through to Jarrod Bowen (West Ham), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
26' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.

25' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
24' Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Michael Oliver blows for a foul. Tottenham have a free kick.
23' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
22' That looked a certain handball by Ben Davies (Tottenham) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
21' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) picks up the rebound on the edge of the box and shoots. His effort, however, only finds the gloves of the opponent's goalkeeper.
19' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
19' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) commits a rough foul. Michael Oliver stops the game and makes a call.
17' West Ham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
15' 0 - 1 Goal Wilson Odobert (Tottenham)! Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) was put through by Mathys Tel and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
14' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
13' What was Ben Davies (Tottenham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
11' Referee Michael Oliver sees the trip by Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
10' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) is caught offside!
8' The game is interrupted. Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
7' Emerson (West Ham) and Lucas Paqueta try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
5' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Tottenham will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Michael Oliver.
